spells.notes: Start is ambiguous by two days. The Blue House announced on Saturday 2000-02-12 that 차관 안병엽 was '승진 임명' (한국경제 2000-02-12 and 2000-02-13, BigKinds 경향신문 2000-02-13 01100101.20000213000000101), and the President handed over the 임명장 on Monday 2000-02-14, which the MSIT list uses as the start. No gazette exists for 2000. End set to the successor's appointment date (same-day handover). The MSIT page gives 2001-03-25, the day before. Later 17th NA member (경기 화성), not a sitting MP during the spell. Birth date from na_members_15_22.csv and ko.wikipedia '안병엽' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42545622 (accessed 2026-09-25T13:12:47-0400, secondary). VERIFIER (disputed start). Two dates are supported. 2000-02-14 is the date on both official lists (current MSIT page and the archived 정보통신부 page of 2005) and the 임명장 and 취임식 day (한국경제 2000-02-14 10:18, 매일신문 2000-02-14, 서울신문 2000-02-15). 2000-02-12 is the day news report as the appointment (한국경제 2000-02-13 17:57 '김대중 대통령은 12일 ... 승진 임명', 경향신문 2000-02-13 BigKinds 01100101.20000213000000101). Gazette practice from 2001-2002 points both ways. 임인택 (관보 제14920호) is dated 2001-09-29, the day his predecessor's 사표 was accepted, although the appointment was reported on 09-30 and his 임명장 came on 2001-10-04. 심상명 (관보 제15249호) is dated 2002-11-09, the 임명장 day, although Yonhap already called him the new minister on the evening of 2002-11-08. labor.partial.json dates 최선정, named in the same 2000-02-12 announcement, at 2000-02-14 as well. Kept 2000-02-14 as better supported (two tier-2 lists plus the 임명장 day and cross-lineage consistency with labor). If 2000-02-12 is adopted, the 2000-02-12..13 vacancy disappears.

issues.desc: 강봉균 end date. Yonhap on 1998-02-26 and 1998-02-27 reports that he left the ministry when he received the 청와대 정책기획수석 임명장 on 1998-02-25 and that 차관 박성득 was acting. The MSIT 역대장관 page gives 1998-03-02 (day before 배순훈). The roster uses 1998-02-25. Either way he was in office on 1998-02-25 and is in the window.

안병엽 start date. Announced as appointed on Saturday 2000-02-12, 임명장 on Monday 2000-02-14. The roster follows the MSIT list and the 임명장 date (2000-02-14). No gazette exists for 2000 to settle which date the appointment carries. If 2000-02-12 is preferred, the 2000-02-12..13 vacancy disappears.

유영환 end date. 정부조직법 법률 제8852호 took effect on 2008-02-29 on publication, abolishing 정보통신부. The roster ends the spell on 2008-02-28 to match offices.json (정보통신부 to 2008-02-28). The MSIT page and same-day news (이임식 on 2008-02-29) support 2008-02-29 as his last day if partial days count.

Same-day handovers. For 안병엽, 양승택 and 이상철 the end equals the successor's gazette appointment date (end_confidence inferred_from_successor). The MSIT page uses the day before the successor for every replaced minister, so its end dates differ by one day by construction.

Vacancies with no minister: 1998-02-26..1998-03-02 (박성득 차관 acting, reported), 1998-12-19..1998-12-20, 2000-02-12..2000-02-13, 2006-03-22..2006-03-27 and 2007-08-28..2007-09-03 (김동수 차관 acting from 2007-08-31, reported). For the other windows the vice minister in post is listed under acting, but no report that names him as 직무대행 was found.

Wikipedia's 정보통신부 page (oldid 40855435) has several wrong dates: 남궁석 end 2000-02-01, 진대제 end and 노준형 start 2006-03-22 (the hearing date), 노준형 end 2007-09-03. The old panel (data/minister_panel_comprehensive.csv) has only three 정보통신부 rows, all with wrong dates, and lacks the 김대중-era ministers (audit coverage_gaps.csv rows for 안병엽, 양승택, 이상철).

Transcript noise. minister_role_meetings.csv has 진대제 as 정보통신부장관 on 2000-07-13 (국회본회의, meeting 28572) and 2000-07-22 (예산결산특별위원회, meeting 28535) and 유영환 on 2003-11-25 (예산결산특별위원회, meeting 31589). These hearing types carry misattached content and were ignored. All valid-type rows fall inside the spells.

Scope. ICT functions returned to cabinet level in 미래창조과학부 (2013-03-23) and 과학기술정보통신부 (2017-07-26). offices.json assigns those offices to the science lineage (primary) with ict as 'also', so their spells are not repeated here. The ict lineage has no 국무위원 office from 2008-02-29 to 2013-03-22. The 2025-2026 news check therefore does not apply to this file.

Gazette coverage. The finished harvest (GAZETTE_DONE present, all 96 months 2001-01..2008-12) contains exactly five 정보통신부장관 appointment notices (양승택, 이상철, 진대제, 노준형, 유영환), matching the roster and the five rows in gazette_cabinet_notices_2001_2026.csv (the parser left 노준형's date blank, the text header gives 2006-03-28). Spells starting before 2001 (배순훈, 남궁석, 안병엽, and 강봉균 in 1996) rest on the MSIT list and news of the day.

VERIFIER. 안병엽 start marked disputed (2000-02-14 kept, 2000-02-12 alternative). Gazette practice 2001-2004 dates appointments sometimes at the decision day (임인택 2001-09-29, 임명장 10-04) and sometimes at the 임명장 day (심상명 2002-11-09, announced 11-08 evening). The same question affects every 1998-2000 appointment whose 임명장 came after the announcement (for example 강봉균 1996-08-08 vs 08-09, 배순훈 1998-03-03 vs 03-04) and should be settled by one rule across lineages.

This matters for the interior, health, environment and agriculture lineages, not for ict.

The archived 정보통신부 website (web.archive.org captures of www.mic.go.kr/mic/intro_past_min_mic.jsp and intro_past_min_mic_02.jsp, 2003-07-24, 2005-03-07 and 2005-09-15, snapshots in sources/ict/verify/wayback/) lists 역대 장관 경상현, 이석채, 강봉균, 배순훈, 남궁석, 안병엽, 양승택, 이상철 with dates.
